topic.description: Information about joining the Brownton swimming pool water polo club, age groups, training schedules, and registration requirements.

contextPassage.title: Brownton Swimming Pool - Water Polo Club Info
contextPassage.summary: Brownton Swimming Pool offers water polo clubs for under 14s, under 16s, under 18s, and adults. Members must complete a registration form and submit a photograph to join.
